import subprocess
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
python=str(repo/'.venv/bin/python')
preview=subprocess.run([python,'jobpipe.py','apply-csv','--priorities','Medium','--statuses','Needs user','--limit','1','--preview'],cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=45)
if preview.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(f'PREVIEW_FAILED exit={preview.returncode}')
jobs=json.loads(preview.stdout).get('jobs',[])
if len(jobs)!=1 or jobs[0].get('company')!='Alteryx':
    raise SystemExit('LIVE_RUN_ABORTED unexpected job selection')
cmd=[python,'jobpipe.py','apply-csv','--priorities','Medium','--statuses','Needs user','--limit','1','--headless','--continue-on-user']
result=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=270)
safe=result.stdout
safe=re.sub(r'(?i)[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}', '[redacted-email]', safe)
safe=re.sub(r'/Users/steventran/[^\s"]+', '[local-path]',safe)
safe=re.sub(r'https?://[^\s"]+', '[url]', safe)
print('LIVE_NON_SUBMIT_ATTEMPTED=true')
print('TARGET_COMPANY=Alteryx')
print('REQUEST_SUBMIT=false')
print('exit_code=',result.returncode)
print('stdout_tail=',safe[-16000:])
print('stderr_tail=',result.stderr[-1400:])
